title: font pairing
category: sub-skill of image-to-react · primary / secondary / tertiary type system
short_summary: locks every build to one role-based type system: primary for headlines and subheadlines, secondary for body and ui, at most one tertiary accent (<= 15% of text), a monotonic modular scale, and zero fallback leaks, verified in the live dom by eval-font-pairing.py.
when_to_use: use in stage 1a of jason-dev-agent when wiring the fonts chosen by jason-design-agent or auditing typography consistency.
summary: Locks every Golden Template React build to one strong, role-based type system inside jason-dev-agent: a primary family for headlines and subheadlines, a secondary family for body and UI, and at most one optional tertiary accent family (eyebrows, h4-h6 subheads, tabular numerals, mono labels) capped at 15 percent of text, with a monotonic modular type scale and zero fallback-font leaks. Takes the live Google Fonts chosen by jason-design-agent via google-font-selection, maps them to roles and Tailwind tokens, and verifies the shipped DOM with eval-font-pairing.py. Use whenever wiring fonts, defining the type scale, or auditing typography consistency in a build. Don't use for ranking fonts from a mood or keyword (use google-font-selection).
